item.title: Reading the signals: Helping your AI-built payment integration understand business intent
item.description: The low-level code that makes a payment go through is getting cheap, fast. What is becoming valuable is the judgment above it: knowing what the money is supposed to do and making sure the code obeys it.

item.title: Agentic payments for marketplaces: How a smart fridge can shop safely
item.description: While a smart fridge can detect when a household is running out of milk, the more interesting engineering problem begins after that.

item.title: Meet Stripe's Knowledge AI Platform
item.description: Stripe's Knowledge AI Platform is our versatile AI agent platform built to handle diverse non-coding knowledge work, from quick queries to complex, multi-day projects. By connecting employees to over 1,000 internal tools and skills, it enables secure, enterprise-scale productivity across the organization.

item.title: How Stripe uses graph search and state machines to auto-remediate a global database fleet
item.description: Discover how we modeled our MongoDB infrastructure as a traversable graph and then use pathfinding algorithms to dynamically compute and execute recovery plans. This automated approach reduced pager volume by 30% (~200 pages/year), eliminated 12 days of unhealthy shard states annually, and supports new shard layouts with zero manual effort.

item.title: Keeping funds where they belong: Implementing fund segregation in Stripe Connect
item.description: Learn how to implement fund segregation in Stripe Connect using allocated balances to ring-fence seller funds from your platform's operational balance - covering payment creation, transfers, refunds, disputes, and preparing for upcoming PSD3 regulatory requirements.

item.title: Introducing a better way to process Stripe's thin events
item.description: Event destinations are central to Stripe integrations but hard to get right. Event notification handlers encapsulate the setup and wiring, letting you focus on business logic and surface errors at development time instead of in production.

item.title: What it feels like building with Stripe Projects
item.description: Building a GitHub traffic dashboard with Stripe Projects revealed a surprising shift from “AI coding” into real infrastructure orchestration. In under an hour, Auth0, Supabase, Vercel, Prisma, deployments, environments, and scheduled jobs materialized around an idea with remarkable speed. The experience highlighted both the power and the emerging challenge of AI-assisted infrastructure: operational visibility, ownership clarity, environment management, and understanding rapidly orchestrated systems.

item.title: You can't whisper at an AI agent
item.description: What a dozen steering experiments taught us about how LLM-based agents actually behave in the wild.

item.title: From init to deploy: building with agents and Stripe Projects
item.description: Stripe Projects makes it easy to spin up a useful, complex application that uses various SaaS providers. This post describes how one of our developer advocates built an internal transcript editing application using Stripe Projects, Vercel, and OpenRouter.

item.title: Formatting an entire 25 million line codebase overnight: the rubyfmt story
item.description: This is the story of how our Developer Productivity team extended and rolled out rubyfmt, our Rust-based zero-config, ultra-fast autoformatter across the world's largest Ruby codebase.

item.title: Selective Test Execution at Stripe: Fast CI for a 50M-line Ruby monorepo
item.description: Stripe's Selective Test Execution system employs some clever tricks to allow us to continue scaling our team and our codebase while only running around 5% of our tests on average. Find out how it works!

item.title: Provision a production-ready dev stack from your terminal
item.description: Provision hosting, databases, auth, analytics, AI and other dev tools from the Stripe CLI. Stripe Projects creates real resources in your own provider accounts, securely syncs agent-ready credentials, supports upgrades to paid tiers, and handles payments without leaving the terminal.
